Container.Name: MailFlow-frontend
Container.Overview: Browser interface for MailFlow, a self-hosted webmail client for existing IMAP/SMTP accounts. Serves the React application through nginx and proxies API/WebSocket requests to backend:3000. Install MailFlow-backend first on the same network. HTTPS uses a generated self-signed certificate unless you provide cert.pem and key.pem. HTTP is intended for a trusted TLS-terminating reverse proxy.
Container.Requires: Create the user-defined Docker network mailflow-network before installation. Requires MailFlow-backend on that network with alias backend and internal port 3000, plus its configured PostgreSQL and Redis services. Set APP_URL and FRONTEND_URL in the backend to the URL users actually visit. Certificate storage must be writable.

Config.Name: HTTPS web interface
Config.Description: Host HTTPS port. Change if occupied; the WebUI link follows this mapping.

Config.Name: HTTP reverse-proxy port
Config.Description: Host HTTP port for a TLS-terminating reverse proxy. Forward X-Forwarded-Proto: https. Restrict access appropriately.

Config.Name: TLS certificate storage
Config.Description: Persistent writable certificate directory. Supply cert.pem and key.pem, or the container generates a self-signed pair at startup.

Config.Name: Backend hostname
Config.Description: Backend hostname or IPv4 address reachable from this container. Default uses the backend network alias. Recent frontend images support this override; IPv6 literals are not supported.

Config.Name: Backend port
Config.Description: Port reachable at BACKEND_HOST. Use internal port 3000 for the supplied backend on the shared network.

Config.Name: Application URL
Config.Description: Optional frontend compatibility setting: use the same browser-facing URL as backend APP_URL. Frontend consumption is not yet verified; this does not replace the required backend URL settings.
